fusions.name: Hook and Heave
fusions.desc: Hooks the target between the tines for 12 damage and heaves it 3 tiles away, leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Overarm Hurl
fusions.desc: Hurls the whole polearm overarm into the first enemy it meets within 10 tiles for 30 piercing damage, plus 5% of a boss or elite's maximum health. It has a 50% chance to turn the target against its allies for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Drummed Challenge
fusions.desc: Increases your piercing damage by 30% for 10 seconds, and pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Prised Open
fusions.desc: Your physical attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour.
